title: Does VisuStella have a holder script?

posts.author: CrystalCat
posts.body:
I made a similar post a while ago so sorry for the repetition! basically I'm using holder's battlers for my MZ project with
Akeas Animated Battlers
, which is what holder has linked in his scripts for MZ. however... VisuStella's battle core is completely incompatible with it, and in my last post people explained that it changes so much no amount of changing parameters can save it. I really, really need some of VisuStella's scripts for some aspects of my game, but some of them rely on the battle core to function (yes, i have looked at VisuStella alternatives). but here's the weird part. in holders page, he has VisuStella's page listed right under akea's script in the scripts box, but doesn't lead to a specific script (
Image
). if VisuStella has a script that lets you use holder's battlers, that would solve almost all of my problems, but i couldn't find one when i looked at her page. does she have one? if so, please link it

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
A couple of tips to help you get more people responding and giving good answers to your posts.
- It's worth taking a few seconds to apply basic formatting. There are people who will see your huge block of text and just click out of the thread. Doing line breaks every couple of sentences makes it much easier to read.
- The term for MV and MZ is plugin, not script.
Also, whatever you're trying to show in the link that says "image" wasn't linked correctly, so we don't know what you're trying to show us.
(Also also, VisuStella is a team, not a "she")
The answer is no, Akea's Animated Battlers was specifically written to construct the layers of Holder's battlers, and there is not a VisuStella version that I'm aware of.

posts.body: I’m not familiar with Holder’s format, but wouldn’t it be mostly a matter of rearranging the sprite sheet?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
werzaque said:
I’m not familiar with Holder’s format, but wouldn’t it be mostly a matter of rearranging the sprite sheet?
Click to expand...
The point is that his sprites are constructed dynamically so you see the battlers holding the specific weapons in all of their motions without having to create separate spritesheets for everything.
So, yes, you could do that manually and use them with all of VisuStella's plugins.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
You don't need to resize anything.
If you read MZ's instructions under Help -> Contents -> Documentation -> Asset Standards, side view battlers can be any size.

you want
to use Holder's sprites, and if
you want

you do not
have the programming skills to make your own plugin, and
you also do not
have the funds to hire someone who is experienced in building plugins atop of Visustella's obfuscated plugins, I think the only option open is to give up on Akea's Animated Battlers (cue lyrics by Mick Jagger and Keith Richards).

posts.author: Holder

Hereiti has a program called 'RPG Maker - Set Manager' it's a tool with many great functions. Long story short they included a function to convert my sheets into default MV/MZ sheets.
This arranges the sheet and removes the extra smooth animation frame.
RPG Maker - Set Manager by Hereiti
rpgmaker_setmanager
hereiti.itch.io

Thanks, I actually downloaded your entire free set yesterday to have a look.
So
@CrystalCat
, it’s all a matter of where your priorities are! If you’re not happy with three frames, Lib’s battle motion MZ is like 95% seamlessly compatible with Visustella Battle Core. If the weapon overlay is a requirement, just don’t use Visustella (well, technically you could create animation overlays for the weapons… lots of work, though).
This is a decision that has consequences, and the earlier you make it the better (I chose to stick with Visustella, but it requires patience, willingness to compromise, and the occasional Andrew Jackson flying away because you need help from someone who has experience with patching Visustella).
